key_insight: X^3-OPD teaches large audio-language models to reason better by distilling step-by-step reasoning from a strong text-only teacher during training. The key idea is to align audio model outputs with high-quality reasoning trajectories, even when direct audio reasoning data is scarce.
problem_solved: Large audio-language models can perceive audio well, but they often struggle with deeper logical reasoning because there is little high-quality audio reasoning data available for training.
method: Use a powerful text-based teacher to generate or guide reasoning trajectories.
Train the audio-language student with an on-policy distillation framework so it learns from its own generated reasoning paths.
Cross-modal alignment transfers reasoning ability from text to audio without needing large-scale labeled audio reasoning datasets.
impact: This approach helps close the reasoning gap between audio-language models and text LLMs, making audio AI more capable on tasks that require multi-step inference. For practitioners, it offers a practical training recipe when annotated audio reasoning data is limited.

paper_title: X$^3$-OPD: Distilling Reasoning into Large Audio-Language Models via On-Policy Alignment
paper_authors: Dongjie Fu, Di Cao, Xize Cheng, Zihan Zhang, Wenxu Jia
